title: Catalogue of published reactions and the daily calendar
description: catalogue.json, written by the catalogue build (src/catalogueBuilding) and read by the learner site (src/catalogue). See docs/schema-design.md section 6.

builtAt.description: UTC time of the build, e.g. 2026-12-01T10:00:00Z.

reactions.description: One entry per reaction slug, sorted by slug.

tracks.description: The Learn tracks, compiled from content/tracks/ (docs/schema-design.md section 6.1), sorted by slug: only published set items, no empty problem set or track. Absent in catalogues built before item 9.

dateToDailyReactionVersionRef.description: The daily calendar: a learner's local date to the reaction version played that day. Dates are never removed or changed by a later build.

catalogueTrack.description: A track file without its formatVersion; the problem sets, level and curriculum code are those of schema/track.schema.json. level and curriculumCode are absent in catalogues built before item 11; showcaseReactionSlug is absent then too, and when its reaction is not published.

showcaseProductState.description: Where the showcase reaction's preferred route ends (its main product), drawn after the arrow on the track's card; present with showcaseReactionSlug.

reactionVersionToContentHash.description: Every published version of the reaction to the full sha256 hex digest of its canonical file; the static file name uses the first 8 characters.

conditionsLabel.description: The latest version's conditionsLabel, written over the arrow of the reaction's card. Absent in catalogues built before item 11.

startState.description: The latest version's start state as the reaction's card draws it. Absent in catalogues built before item 11.

abbreviatedGroups.description: The latest version's abbreviatedGroups (schema/reaction.schema.json), when it has any.

schemeState.description: A state's drawing fields, as in schema/reaction.schema.json: what a card needs to draw it.
